selection: Explicit --protocol v4 --descriptor-collector libproc-v1 only. Ordinary v4 retains lsof, and previous declarations/results/binary identities remain unchanged. New reports identify both companion hashes; do not pool collectors or retrofit historical verification.
build: Compile the exact allowlisted descriptor-collector.c once into an owned private temporary directory before any services/timed intervals, with the active SDK headers and compiler. Record C source/helper/compiler/SDK-header hashes, compiler version and SDK version. Build output is bounded to1MiB with30s deadline and100ms termination grace; compiler warnings/errors, truncation, cancellation or inability to identify inputs fails preflight. No source cache, runtime dependency, unsafe Rust or privileged process inspection is added.
collection: Inherit the immutable design's131072-record maximum,3 list attempts,1MiB stdout,2s deadline and100ms grace. Require exact fixed JSON schema with one trailing newline, verified collected status/count<=131072 or known failure status/count=null. Any stderr, malformed/extra output, failed child, timeout or cancellation yields unverified/count=null. A zero/failed list result remains unverified rather than guessing an empty valid snapshot. Linux retains numeric /proc/PID/fd enumeration unchanged.
tests: A separately compiled AUTOROUTER_FD_TEST helper controls growth, alignment, duplicate/negative records, integer overflow, before/after process-identity change and never-returning collection. This artifact is never used for measurements and has its own hash. An owned real idle child opens/closes a pipe to verify a+2 then restored count; an exited/reaped PID is unavailable, not verified zero. Independent owner cancellation terminates/reaps the blocked helper. Privacy/parser controls reject extra fields, stale schemas, count/status contradictions and warnings.
qualification: This is a development collector capability, not a measured resource result. No new descriptor acceptance threshold, no hardware approval and no relaxation of any inherited sample/workload/resource/latency bound. Validation strips descriptor counts and keeps verification/failure outcomes. New numerical comparisons need unchanged five fresh paired rounds and immutable final source/binary identity.
